title: Bill Watterson’s College Comics
content: Online College Courses has assembled a list oftop ten college comic strips:“What did Bill Watterson do before creating the beloved Calvin and Hobbes? He drew cartoons for his college newspaper, of course. As a student at Kenyon College, his work appeared in The Kenyon Collegian, revealing a well defined style even in his early years as a comic. Be sure to check out the collection of his college work and enjoy a slice of 70′s American college life.”More samples of Watterson’s college work atComics AllianceOnline College’s list ofTop Ten College Comics
